candidates.title: Guidelines for usage of Track Guidance Assistants for Inland Navigation (TGAIN)
candidates.summary_from_feed: TGAIN systems support the user by automatically steering a vessel along a predefined track. Their use on board inland barges has increased significantly in recent years. This information paper provides safe practice recommendations related to performance criteria, installation and implementation of TGAIN devices on board.
